name: mya
description: MYA: a voice for Claude Code on Linux/X11. Tap Right Ctrl to talk, Right Ctrl + Space to translate, and MYA answers aloud, with a ringing phone when it is your turn.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: Deepgram language code of what you say (en, fr, es, de...).

keyterms.title: Words to recognise
keyterms.description: Comma-separated names or jargon Deepgram should favour. 'Mya' is the default so it is not heard as 'I car'.

translateTo.title: Translate into
translateTo.description: Language name for Right Ctrl + Space (e.g. English, French, Spanish).

speakReplies.title: Speak replies
speakReplies.description: MYA reads Claude's answer aloud when you sent the question by voice.

voiceId.title: Cartesia voice id
voiceId.description: Cartesia voice id. Empty = MYA's original voice (Katie).

micDevice.title: Microphone (ALSA)
micDevice.description: 'auto' prefers a USB microphone; otherwise an ALSA device such as plughw:1,0 (see `arecord -l`).

speakerDevice.title: Speaker (ALSA)
speakerDevice.description: ALSA playback device; 'default' is the system default.

python.title: Python command
python.description: Python 3 used for the helper scripts (standard library only).

envFile.title: Env file with the API keys
envFile.description: Optional path to a file containing DEEPGRAM_API_KEY=... and CARTESIA_API_KEY=... lines, read by the helpers (never printed). Alternative to the key options or your shell environment.

chordKeycode.title: Translate chord key (X11 keycode)
chordKeycode.description: Pressed while the dictation key is held. 65 = Space.

lockKeycode.title: Hotkey on/off key (X11 keycode)
lockKeycode.description: Pressed while the dictation key is held, it switches the hotkey on or off. 62 = Right Shift.

maxTapSeconds.title: Longest tap (seconds)
maxTapSeconds.description: A dictation key held longer than this is not a tap, so holding Ctrl for copy-paste or Ctrl+click never starts the microphone.

hotkeyOnStart.title: Hotkey on at start
hotkeyOnStart.description: Whether the Right Ctrl hotkey is active when the session starts.

deepgramApiKey.title: Deepgram API key
deepgramApiKey.description: Speech-to-text. Or set DEEPGRAM_API_KEY in your environment.

cartesiaApiKey.title: Cartesia API key
cartesiaApiKey.description: Text-to-speech (optional). Or set CARTESIA_API_KEY in your environment.

voiceEngine.title: MYA's engine
voiceEngine.description: cartesia = a human-like cloud voice (default); machine = a formant synthesizer (eSpeak NG, local, no key; speaks one language, so replies are condensed and translated into it). piper = a local neural voice (free, offline, about 5x faster than speech on a modest CPU; needs `pip install piper-tts` for the Python you set below and a voice file in piperModel). Piper is GPL-3.0 and is NOT bundled: you install it yourself.

piperModel.title: Piper voice file
piperModel.description: Path to a Piper .onnx voice (its .onnx.json must sit next to it), e.g. fr_FR-siwis-medium.onnx. Only used when the engine is piper.

machineVoice.title: Machine voice (eSpeak NG)
machineVoice.description: Machine engine only: eSpeak NG voice name, language and variant (en-us+klatt4, fr+klatt...). Replies are condensed and translated into this voice's language before being spoken.

machineRate.title: Machine voice rhythm: words per minute
machineRate.description: eSpeak words per minute at speed 1.0. Lower is slower and more deliberate.

machineWordGap.title: Machine voice rhythm: pause between words
machineWordGap.description: Extra silence between words, in tens of milliseconds (0 = none).

voiceStyle.title: MYA's voice
voiceStyle.description: Cartesia engine only: plain (no effect), robot (buzzing 90s computer) or soft (grit only).

voiceSpeed.title: MYA's speaking speed
voiceSpeed.description: 0.5 (slow) to 2.0 (fast); 1.0 is the voice as synthesized. Lower it if a voice talks too fast.

showBand.title: Show MYA above the prompt
showBand.description: A one-line band showing what MYA is doing.

ringSound.title: Ring when it is your turn
ringSound.description: Play an old telephone bell when Claude has finished and is waiting for you (the band always shows a ringing phone).

phrases.title: MYA's own lines
phrases.description: Short spoken lines of MYA's: a greeting at the start, a line when it did not hear you.
